text: Figure 12.3: Flat Map (CommonStrucure: FlatMap) Class FlatMap Package M2::AUTOSARTemplates::CommonStructure::FlatMap Note Contains a ﬂat list of references to software objects. This list is used to identify instances and to resolve name conﬂicts. The scope is given by the RootSwCompositionPrototype for which it is used, i.e. it can be applied to a system, system extract or ECU-extract. An instance of FlatMap may also be used in a preliminary context, e.g. in the scope of a software component before integration into a system. In this case it is not referred by a RootSwCompositionPrototype.
